current_u_probe.interpretation: For the deliberately overlapping case Sy=u=0.20, the current positive u/dt affine response does not reproduce the 8.05 m physical oracle. This is a bounded counterexample to treating the same physical storage as both MODFLOW STO and the current affine response; it is not yet a general production-coupling defect claim.
